raw_text: Planet Labs SkySat imagery acquired on February 10, 2023 reveals continued Eritrean Defence Forces presence in western Tigray. Analysis of multi-temporal imagery confirms new earthworks and defensive positions established after the November 2022 Pretoria agreement. Infrastructure damage assessment shows 47 structures destroyed in Adwa district since January 2023. These findings contradict official claims of full withdrawal.
clean_text: Planet Labs imagery reveals continued Eritrean military presence in western Tigray post-ceasefire. New earthworks and 47 destroyed structures identified in Adwa district since January 2023.
